rec.name: Product Compare Section (Comparison Table)
rec.status: Backlog (spec and design reference only; feasibility question open)

what.text: A standalone, theme-editor-configurable Shopify section called "Compare Section". It shows 2, 3 or 4 hand-picked products side by side in a comparison table. Each product column has an image, title, price (current and struck-through compare-at price), color swatches and a "Zum Produkt" (view product) button. Below the products, rows with a label (e.g. Dimensions, Price, Wood type) show each product's values. An "Alles einblenden" (show all) toggle expands the remaining rows. The section has an optional headline and sub-headline. Desktop shows a label column on the left with product columns to the right. Mobile keeps the same table layout, with 2 products side by side and the labels sitting above their values.

why.text: Shoppers comparing similar products often leave the site to research or abandon because of decision overload. A side-by-side table reduces cognitive load and effort, and makes the differences in specs, price and material explicit. That clarity helps the buyer feel confident choosing, and cuts the back-and-forth between product pages. The "show all" toggle keeps the table short and scannable while the detail stays available. Direct CTA buttons under each product shorten the path from comparison to purchase and can steer shoppers to higher-value options.

how.text: Build a custom section with blocks. Section settings: background color, text color, font size, headline and sub-headline (rich text with bold, italic and underline), number of products (2/3/4), show/hide price toggle, and button color. Product blocks use a product picker. Row-name blocks use rich text for the labels (e.g. Dimensions, Price, Wood type). Each row's comparison values can come from a product metafield or be typed in manually (both options must be supported). Render the product header (image, title, price, swatches, button) first, then a row for each label. Collapse rows beyond the first few behind an "Alles einblenden" toggle. Use a responsive grid so mobile keeps the columns side by side, with the label above the values. One open question from the comments: since metafield names differ per store/theme, the row block should let the merchant pick which existing metafield (namespace.key) feeds each row, instead of fixed 'Comparison Value 1/2/3' fields.

items: Row names (rich text: bold/italic/underline), e.g. Dimensions, Price, Wood type
Comparison data source per row: metafield or manual entry (both supported)
Collapse/expand rows ("Alles einblenden") – visible in the design; not listed as a setting in the ticket

dependencies.text: Product metafields for comparison values, if the metafield data source is used. Metafield definitions differ per store, so the section needs a way to select the metafield for each row (open question in comments). Manual entry removes the metafield dependency. Needs a theme that supports Online Store 2.0 sections/blocks. The reference design is the Impact theme on Holz4Home PDP. No app is required.

items: Click-through rate on the "Zum Produkt" buttons
Add-to-cart rate / conversion rate for sessions that see the section
Scroll depth and visibility of the section
Bounce/exit rate on pages with the section

images.caption: Desktop: label column on the left, two product columns with image, title, sale price with compare-at price, color swatches and "Zum Produkt" button; rows for Dimensions, Price and Wood type; "Alles einblenden" toggle at the bottom.
Mobile: the same table in a compact layout with 2 products side by side; row labels sit above their values; "Alles einblenden" toggle at the bottom.
Rows with row label and value fields (dashed outlines in the editor) show where the rich-text row names and the metafield or manual comparison values appear.
